summary: This Standards Track document points out limits of the dynamic IPv6 multicast address range from RFC 3307 and replaces it with a new IANA registry in the IPv6 Multicast Address Space group, with initial contents including a reduced allocation for MADCAP. It updates RFC 3307.

eli5.summary: The old list of group-chat numbers is too small or awkward, so this builds a new, tidier list.
